title: The Saltkerns 'Wreckers' Roost' (Captain Grael) and the Hollowbrook 'Toll Stones' camp (tollkeeper Grae) reuse near-identical room text and NPC description ('Watches you the way a shopkeeper watches a full pocket') almost verbatim, reading as the same encounter copy-pasted into two holds.
where: the Wreckers' Roost — fire / the Toll Stones — fire
